Costco Credit Card
Reward Certificate FAQs
When and how will I receive my credit card reward certificate?
• I f you are not enrolled in Paperless, your annual credit card reward
certificate will be issued on the last page of your February
paper statement.
• I f you are enrolled in Paperless, your annual credit card reward certificate
will be issued via email on or shortly after your February statement
closing date. No need to print — simply present the certificate on your
mobile device when you are ready to redeem.
• Emailed credit card reward certificates are sent separately and are
not attached to digital statements.
• Anyone who earned a certificate can access it via the Citi Mobile® App.*
Shortly after your February statement closes, just log in and click
“Access Certificate” or “Redeem” to view your certificate on your
mobile device. To download the Citi Mobile App, text “App50” to 692484
or visit the App Store® or Google Play.
Important: To receive a credit card reward certificate, you must have earned $1 or
more in rewards through your December 2025 statement closing date and your
account must be open at the time your certificate is issued, unless prohibited
by law.
*The Citi Mobile® App is available for use with compatible mobile devices. Charges from your mobile carrier may apply.
Costco Credit Card
Reward Certificate FAQs
If I receive my credit card reward certificate via email or access it via
the mobile app, do I need to print it out in order to redeem it?
No, you do not need to print your certificate in order to redeem it. If redeeming
via the mobile app, simply present the certificate on your mobile device at any
U.S. Costco warehouse, including Puerto Rico, when you are ready to redeem.
If redeeming via email, be sure to fully download the email before attempting to
redeem, or save a screenshot to your phone to ensure the certificate barcode is
accessible for scanning. You can also print out your certificate to redeem,
if preferred.
How can I use my credit card reward certificate?
Credit card reward certificates may be redeemed for merchandise or cash back
at any U.S. Costco warehouse, including Puerto Rico. Requests to redeem
the certificate for cash may be fulfilled in an alternative form (e.g., a check or
electronic transfer) at the Costco warehouse’s discretion. Please note that the
certificates cannot be redeemed at Costco.com, Costco Travel, or on the Costco
Mobile® App and cannot be used as payment on your Costco Anywhere Visa®
Card account.
What if I don’t use my entire credit card reward certificate on
my purchase?
Should you choose to redeem only a portion of the certificate for merchandise,
you will receive the remaining balance in cash at the Costco warehouse register
upon checkout.
When does the credit card reward certificate expire?
Your credit card reward certificate from your Costco Anywhere Visa Card expires
on December 31st of the year of issuance. The certificate has no value if not
redeemed in person at any U.S. Costco warehouse, including Puerto Rico, before
the expiration date.

We understand things get lost or misplaced. You can request a replacement

Costco Credit Card
Reward Certificate FAQs
Keeping track of your certificate
Each replacement certificate will have a new two-digit number in the upper right
corner and a unique barcode for redemption. Only the most current certificate
can be redeemed at Costco.
You can also request a replacement certificate by calling Citi customer service at
1-877-419-4002 (TTY: We accept 711 or other Relay Service).
What is the number in the upper right corner of my credit card
reward certificate?
• T his is your certificate number. If you request a replacement, your
certificate will be assigned a new, unique certificate number, and you
will no longer be able to redeem your prior one.
• You can verify your current certificate number by logging in to Citi.com
and visiting the Rewards Details Page or by calling 1-877-419-4002
(TTY: We accept 711 or other Relay Service).
I have multiple Costco Anywhere Visa® Card accounts. Will I receive
separate credit card reward certificates?
• Yes, you will receive separate reward certificates for each Costco Anywhere
Visa Card account you have, so long as you are eligible and are the Primary
Cardholder on each account.
What happens to my credit card reward certificate if I cancel my
Costco membership?
• I f you no longer have a valid Costco membership, you’ll be notified that
your Costco Anywhere Visa Card will be closed. Any cash back rewards
accumulated but not yet distributed in the form of a credit card reward
certificate will be forfeited, unless prohibited by law.
• I f your credit card reward certificate is already issued before your account
is closed, then you can still redeem it at any U.S. Costco warehouse,
including Puerto Rico, through December 31st of the issuance year. You
do not need an active Costco membership to redeem your credit card
reward certificate for cash at the member services desk at any Costco
warehouse in the U.S., including Puerto Rico.
Costco Credit Card
Reward Certificate FAQs
• One convenient way to ensure that your Costco membership stays
active is to have your annual membership fee automatically billed to your
Costco Anywhere Visa® Card. Please contact Costco at 1-800-774-2678
(TTY: Costco accepts 711 or other Relay Service) to enroll in the
membership Auto Renew feature if you are not already enrolled.
I just received my February statement from Citi and I do not see a
credit card reward certificate in my billing statement. Why?
• I f you are enrolled in Paperless with Citi, then you will receive your credit
card reward certificate in a separate email shortly after your February
statement closes. The credit card reward certificate will not be included
as part of your digital statement.
• Please confirm that you are reviewing the correct billing statement.
If your statement closes late in the month, you may not receive your
February billing statement until early March.
• T o determine the month of each billing statement, look at the gray box in
the upper left section of the statement. The example shown below is the
February billing statement, which closed on the 24th.
1/25/26 – 2/24/26
FEBRUARY STATEMENT
Minimum payment due: $25.00
New balance as of 2/24/26: $849.26
• Y ou may view more about the status of your credit card reward certificate
by visiting the Rewards Details Page on Citi.com.
• O therwise, please call 1-877-419-4002 (TTY: We accept 711 or other
Relay Service) or send us a secure message online to inquire about your
reward certificate.

Costco Credit Card
Reward Certificate FAQs
How do I confirm that the total value of my credit card reward
certificate is accurate?
If you’d like to verify your reward amount for 2026, you can do this by reviewing
each statement between January 2025 and December 2025. If you became
a cardholder after January 2025 and were not a cardholder for the full year,
simply look at the reward amounts reported beginning with your first statement
through your December 2025 statement.
• The amount listed on the right side of your statement shows the total
cumulative rewards earned through your billing date.
Costco Cash Back
Rewards Summary
as of 12/24/25
• Y ou can also review each statement period individually by looking on
page 2 of your statement and adding “Earned this period” amounts for
each eligible billing statement to determine the value of your
reward certificate.
What has changed about how I earn Costco Cash Back Rewards?
• As of January 19, 2025, we enhanced the Costco Cash Back Rewards
Program. You earn 5% cash back rewards on gas purchases at Costco
worldwide and 4% cash back on other eligible gas and electric vehicle
(EV) charging purchases worldwide, for the first $7,000 per year in
combined gas at Costco and/or other eligible gas and/or EV charging
purchases, then 1% cash back thereafter.
• This change is reflected in your 2026 cash back rewards balance, based
on transactions made between January 19, 2025, and December 2025.
Costco Credit Card
Reward Certificate FAQs
How do I know which statement I’m looking at and what my billing
period is?
• You can determine the month of each billing statement by looking at the
gray box in the upper left section of your statement.
• The example shown below is a February billing statement, which closed
on the 24th.
1/25/26 – 2/24/26
FEBRUARY STATEMENT
Minimum payment due: $25.00
New balance as of 2/24/26: $849.26
I am a Costco Executive Member. What’s the difference between my
credit card reward certificate and my Executive Member
annual reward?
• Your credit card reward certificate reflects the cash back rewards earned
on your Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi. These cash back rewards are
distributed annually by Citi after your February statement closes.
• If you are a Costco Executive Member, you will also receive an Executive
Membership 2% Reward certificate. These rewards are distributed
annually by Costco via mail two months prior to your annual
renewal month.
My credit card reward certificate reads “2026,” but the year just
started. What happened to my 2025 rewards?
• The year on the credit card reward certificate reflects the year in which
the certificate is issued and redeemable, not the year the rewards
were earned.
• Your cash back rewards earned for purchases on your January 2025
through December 2025 statements are reflected in your 2026 credit
card reward certificate.
